sources.coveragePolicy: Explicit non-identity ranges only. Unlisted Isaiah coordinates retain their source edition; no inferred identity mapping.
sources.mappingSource: STEPBible TVTMS Hebrew-to-English-KJV alignment plus direct comparison of the checked-in SCH2000 text and pinned eBible Luther 1912 USFM.

Direct comparison of the checked-in SCH2000 verses and pinned eBible Luther 1912 USFM. SCH2000 joins both greetings at 2 Corinthians 13:12; Luther splits 12/13. The peace/greeting closing of 3 John is 14-15 versus 14. The shoreline clause is SCH2000 Revelation 12:18 versus the opening of Luther 13:1.
sources.coveragePolicy: Explicit non-identity ranges and their merge companions. Cross-chapter reverse merges remain in the source edition. No a/b verse subdivision.

Whole native marker units in four independent structures must match exactly. Existing reviewed books and CrossWire exception chapters are excluded. Unlisted coordinates retain source edition; no a/b split.
sources.publisherCacheHashMethod: SHA-256 over sorted structure-root-relative POSIX path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL for each JSON

sources.method: Same-coordinate identity only for complete native units untouched by existing exception rules; combined lines remain whole. Non-English base stories require fresh hash-bound rendered Bible.com parity. Text similarity is diagnostic, not a gate.
